title: GoodServe: Towards High-Goodput Serving of Agentic LLM Inferences over Heterogeneous Resources
authors: Boxiao Du; Boning Huangfu; Yizhou Luo; Chen Chen; Zijun Li; Minchen Yu; Xiaoyi Fan; Minyi Guo
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen), Shenzhen MSU-BIT University
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Length prediction, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM inferences require fully-formed outputs, making end-to-end latency (TTLT) SLOs the key service metric rather than TTFT/TPOT. On heterogeneous GPU pools, existing request-routing strategies (random, round-robin, least-request, prefix-cache, Llumnix, Preble) are SLO-agnostic and, given highly uncertain decode lengths and fluctuating instance capability, fail to attain high goodput.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM inference 需要完整生成的輸出，因此關鍵服務指標是端到端延遲（TTLT）SLO 而非 TTFT/TPOT。在異質 GPU 資源池上，既有的 request routing 策略（random、round-robin、least-request、prefix-cache、Llumnix、Preble）對 SLO 無感知，加上 decode 長度高度不確定與 instance 能力動態波動，難以達成高 goodput。

key_innovation.en: A predict-and-rectify goodput-centric router: a Mixture-of-Experts-style ensemble of small MLPs (TF-IDF features, 45.1M parameters, K=9 experts) predicts request output length; EMA-smoothed black-box profiling estimates each GPU's queuing/prefill/decode coefficients; a just-enough heuristic routes each request to the least-capable instance that still meets its E2E-SLO (O(M) per request), with periodic SLO-risk re-checks triggering token-ID-based (rather than KV-cache) request migration.
key_innovation.zh: 以 predict-and-rectify 方式運作的 goodput 導向 router：以 Mixture-of-Experts 式小型 MLP ensemble（TF-IDF 特徵、共 45.1M 參數、K=9 個 experts）預測請求輸出長度；以 EMA 平滑的 black-box profiling 估計各 GPU 的 queuing/prefill/decode 係數；just-enough 啟發式將請求路由到仍能滿足其 E2E-SLO 的最弱 instance（每請求 O(M)），並定期重估 SLO 違約風險，必要時觸發以 token ID（而非 KV cache）傳輸的 request migration。

baselines_compared: Random, Round-robin, Least-request, Lowest-TPM, Preble, Llumnix

key_improvements.en: Up to 27.4% goodput improvement over the second-best routing method (Preble); token-ID based migration achieves 7.1x-15.3x lower migration latency than KV-cache transfer; per-request routing overhead stays at 5.0 ms even at 10,000 RPS over 512 simulated instances.
key_improvements.zh: goodput 較次佳的 routing 方法（Preble）最高提升 27.4%；以 token ID 為基礎的 migration 延遲較 KV cache 傳輸低 7.1x-15.3x；在 512 個模擬 instance、10,000 RPS 下，每請求 routing 開銷仍僅 5.0 ms。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H800, NVIDIA A800, NVIDIA A40, NVIDIA V100
gpu_count: 4 heterogeneous GPU instances: H800 (80GB), A800 (80GB), A40 (48GB), V100 (32GB, TP=2)
reported_accuracy: Normalized MAE 1.4x lower than LLM-based and up to 3.8x lower than history-based predictors (no absolute MAPE); prediction latency ~2.5 ms per request

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes PD-multiplexed (non-disaggregated) instances, with only an extension path sketched for PD-disaggregated setups; no admission control — requests predicted infeasible are still routed best-effort; EMA-smoothed black-box capability estimation relies on the Law of Large Numbers over batched iterations and short-term stability; predictions are acknowledged imperfect and rectified by SLO-risk re-checks every 50 iterations.
scope_assumptions.zh: 假設 PD-multiplexed（非解耦合）instance，對 PD 解耦合部署僅概述延伸途徑；無 admission control——預測無法達標的請求仍以 best-effort 方式路由；EMA 平滑的 black-box 能力估計依賴批次迭代下的大數法則與短期穩定性；作者承認預測必有誤差，並透過每 50 次迭代的 SLO 違約風險重新檢查加以矯正。
